prayers.title: A Morning Offering
prayers.text: Lord, thank You for the gift of this new day. Before I check my phone or start my work, I give this day to You. Guide my thoughts, guard my words, and help me to love the people You place in my path. Let everything I do today bring You glory. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.title: Morning Prayer from the Psalms
prayers.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

prayers.title: For Strength Today
prayers.text: Father, I do not know everything this day will hold, but You do. Give me strength for every task, patience for every delay, and peace in every moment. When I feel weak, remind me that Your grace is enough. Amen.

prayers.title: An Evening Prayer
prayers.text: Lord, thank You for walking with me through this day. Forgive me where I have fallen short, and help me to forgive others as You have forgiven me. I give You every worry I am carrying. Watch over me and those I love tonight, and let me rest in Your peace. Amen.

prayers.title: Lying Down in Peace
prayers.text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

prayers.title: Search My Heart
prayers.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

sections.title: Prayers from Scripture
sections.subtitle: Words the Church has prayed for centuries

prayers.title: The Lord’s Prayer
prayers.text: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

prayers.title: The Priestly Blessing
prayers.text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

prayers.title: A Clean Heart
prayers.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

prayers.title: Words and Meditations
prayers.text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

prayers.title: For My Family
prayers.text: Father, I lift up my family to You. Protect them, provide for them, and draw each one of them closer to You. Fill our home with patience, kindness, and forgiveness, and let Your love be at the centre of everything we do. Amen.

prayers.title: When I Feel Anxious
prayers.text: Lord, my heart feels heavy and my mind is restless. I give You what I cannot control. Replace my fear with Your peace, and help me to trust that You are with me right now. Amen.

prayers.title: A Prayer of Thanks
prayers.text: Thank You, Lord, for life, for breath, for daily bread, and for Your faithful love. Thank You for the people who love me and for every blessing I have overlooked. Give me a grateful heart in every season. Amen.

prayers.title: For Someone Who Is Hurting
prayers.text: Lord, You are close to the brokenhearted. Be near to those I love who are hurting today. Comfort them, heal them, and let them feel Your presence and Your care. Amen.

prayers.title: Before Work or Study
prayers.text: Lord, bless the work of my hands and the thoughts of my mind today. Give me wisdom, focus, and integrity, and help me to serve others well in everything I do. Amen.
